lines: עוֹד בְּתוֹךְ קִבְרוֹ יִשְׁכַּב אִלֵּם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּר

review: 1:2 יְחַיֶּה כֹּל — piel participle of חיה, 'gives life to all'; the alternative מְחַיֶּה is the same form with a full prefix vowel and upsets the syllable count.
2:1 שֵׂה הָאֱלֹהִים — the Johannine title (John 1:29); the Arabic has only 'O Lamb', the fuller title is kept because the hymn's whole argument is the blood of the Lamb.
3:2 לִפְנֵי־עוֹלָם — 'before the world', for تَعَيَّنَ مُنْذُ الْأَزَل (appointed from eternity).
4:2 בְּתוֹךְ קִבְרוֹ אִלֵּם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּר — 'dumb in its grave and it will not speak', for أَخْرَسَ لَنْ يُكَلِّمَ; the subject is still the tongue of 4:1.
